description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game Sun & Moon series on 9 December 2016, released together with Collection Moon. The two wrappers show the legendary Solgaleo and Lunala against the sun and the moon. Collection Sun holds Solgaleo-GX with Lapras-GX, Espeon-GX and Gumshoos-GX, among many new Pokémon of the Alola region. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Ilima and Professor Kukui, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Ultra Ball, Rotom Dex and Metal Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Sun & Moon in February 2017.

Sun & Moon brought Pokémon-GX. Each has a GX attack, a powerful move modeled on the games' Z-Moves that a player may use only once a game. The series also added the Hyper Rare, a card whose whole surface shines in rainbow colors, between Super Rare and Ultra Rare.
